expectation.note: Recorded, not scored. 2011-12-30 did not exist in Samoa: the zone jumped from 2011-12-29T23:59:59-10:00 to 2011-12-31T00:00:00+14:00. The 'interpret using the offset before the gap' rule of §3.3.5 yields 2011-12-30T12:00:00-10:00 = 2011-12-30T22:00:00Z, which lands on 2011-12-31T12:00 local — a full calendar day later in local terms.

rationale: The pathological case for every gap policy: the 'gap' is 24 hours wide and the pre-gap-offset rule produces a wall time on a different date. Any product claiming a DST policy must state what it does here.
title: A monthly recurrence across the Apia date-line jump
